tests.description: a known agent variable sets client.env.agent to the agent's name
a known agent's name does not depend on the value of its variable
the first known agent in the list wins
a known agent wins over the generic AI_AGENT variable
AI_AGENT with a descriptive value is reported as it is
AI_AGENT with the value true is reported as ai_agent
AI_AGENT is normalized before it is compared to true
AI_AGENT is truncated on a character boundary
an empty AI_AGENT is not populated
a whitespace-only AI_AGENT is not populated
no agent variable means no client.env.agent
client.env.agent is reported alongside FaaS metadata
